{{Top|leg}}
'''Docking Bay 45''' was a holding bay in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] spaceport on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] escaped from this docking bay in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] by illegally using the [[Telesponder|identification profile]] from another ship.
